news.title: Witness called 911 after finding plane crash in Gwinnett woods
news.summary: A witness who came upon a deadly plane crash in Gwinnett County said he saw someone moving inside the wreckage and called 911.

news.title: DeKalb crews respond to fire, gunfire and pedestrian strike
news.summary: Several overnight incidents kept DeKalb County first responders busy, including a house fire in Dunwoody, a car struck by gunfire and a reported pedestrian strike in Decatur.

news.title: Two shooting scenes about a mile apart under investigation in Atlanta
news.summary: Authorities initially believed the two scene may have been connected; but in an update, they indicated they are unrelated at this time.

news.title: DeKalb County Police officer facing felony amid criminal drug investigation, department says
news.summary: The officer is on administrative leave while the investigation continues.

news.title: Suspect wanted in Atlanta shooting that killed young mother turns himself in, authorities say
news.summary: Atlanta Police said 23-year-old Torodd Woods surrendered to the Douglas County Sheriff's Office.

news.title: Murder suspect on Atlanta Police 'Most Wanted' list captured in Coweta County, FBI says
news.summary: Mi'Quae Williams is charged in a 2023 shooting that occurred outside a music studio on Ralph David Abernathy Blvd.
